overview_description.description: Titipku is an online shopping app that focuses on facilitating the needs of everyday consumers. Prioritizing the shopping point feature of the traditional market, Titipku is committed to being a hyperlocal shopping app targeting the sub-district area. The goal is that consumers can shop at the market/shop closest to their homes.
